messages:
maria_cs: Quick alert — account Aurelia (acct 4421) shows a sharp activation drop to ~12% DAU after renewal moved them to Basic. Thinking a targeted one-week reactivation + short credit to unblock. Who can own outreach and a quick enablement session this week?
jason_csm: I can lead outreach and run the 15-min check-in. Need latest usage numbers + any open tickets to reference.
opsbot: health-signal: account=4421 signal=activation_drop severity=medium last_active=2026-03-15 daily_active_pct=12% recent_tickets=2
kevin_se: Noted — there's an onboarding migration they started (webhook v1->v2). Support ticket #7842 flagged 502s; I can join the call for quick triage.
anna_support: I can run a focused 30-min product tune-up (screen-share) to validate webhook config, auth, and retry policy. I have a 1-slide checklist.
sam_ae: Heads up from AE — they were earmarked for a larger commit, then paused after slow setup. Price sensitivity exists; recommend the credit be strictly time-limited and tied to success checkpoints.
maria_cs: Draft short play below. Keep outreach concise and factual.

Play: Short Activation Boost (1-week credit + tune-up)
- Step 0 (ASAP): CSM (Jason) sends 1-line DM + calendar poll for 15-min check-in. Tone: help-first, no pressure.
- Step 1 (within 48h): Offer one-week free credit roughly equal to 1 month typical spend (finance pre-approved for <=1 month) + schedule 30-min tune-up (Anna).
- Step 2 (during week): Engineering triage from Kevin if integration errors; apply quick config fixes; track event flow & DAU.
- Step 3 (EOW): Measure recovery vs baseline. If DAU recovers >= 40% of prior baseline, propose phased re-up with onboarding SLA and weekly check-ins for 30 days. Otherwise escalate renewal owner.

DM/email snippet: "Hey <Name> — noticed usage dropped. Can we do a 15-min check-in this week? We can provide a one-week credit and a quick product tune-up to help unblock webhooks. No long-term change — just want to get you back to productive usage."

jason_csm: I'll send that copy now. Can someone paste the quick usage query I should run so I have fresh DAU on the call?
maria_cs: Use the quick query (last 30d):
```
SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM analytics.events
WHERE account_id = 4421 AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY account_id;
```
kevin_se: I'll prep a short troubleshooting checklist for the call (curl health checks, header diffs v1->v2, sample retry policy).
anna_support: I'll prep the 30-min deck + upload the checklist to shared drive. Recommend polling availability for next 48 hours.
sam_ae: Finance, please note: quick approval for up to 1 month equivalent credit is OK if CSM confirms acceptance.

jason_csm: Poll sent. Call booked for tomorrow 14:30 PST. Will post notes here after.
maria_cs: After the call, paste a 2-line summary here with action items and whether they accepted the credit. If accepted, tag Sam for the finance approval line.
jason_csm: Call update: admin confirmed webhook retries failing, accepted one-week credit, scheduled Anna's tune-up. Kevin to attempt remote triage immediately after the call.
kevin_se: Triage done — root cause was missing retry header and an old client library that didn't surface 5xx retries. Pushed a small config change and suggested client update. Event backlog is draining.
anna_support: Tune-up complete. We applied recommended retry policy and validated payloads. Immediately saw increase in event throughput. Uploaded deck + checklist: https://redwood.box.com/s/aurelia-tune
jason_csm: End-of-week metric check: DAU rose to ~33% (from 12%). Customer is positive and agreed to a phased re-up contingent on a 30-day onboarding SLA. I tagged finance for the one-week credit.
maria_cs: Great work. I'll convert this to a short play doc for our library. Tag me when the finance note is posted.
sam_ae: Finance approved one-week credit (<=1 month equivalent) in thread. Please include amount in renewal notes.

-- end thread --
